summary: Full end-to-end frontend testing of the new guided Production Run Wizard on /production-batches. All wizard scenarios PASS: initiate → pre-checklist with param capture → start (blocked until all_clear) → stop with crates → post-checklist auto-appears → create-batch section prefilled → close with edited crates=42 → batch detail with production-run-panel & PDF link → in-progress badge/resume tag on list card → banner + Resume button on batch detail → cancel run deletes draft. Legacy 'Quick create (legacy)' modal opens with batch-total-crates-input and run-flow-hint visible for admins. Backend regression re-verified via /app/backend/tests/manual_run_wizard.py (initiate 200, 2nd initiate + cancel 200, start blocked 409, clear w/o params 400, clear 200, start 200, stop 200, close blocked 409, post complete 200, close dup 400, close 200, PDF 200 application/pdf, cancel closed 409).

test_results.backend_regression_manual_run_wizard: PASS — all 12 lifecycle steps returned expected status codes; final batch persisted with editable code ZZ-WIZ-FINAL, total_crates=42, bottles=1008, status=created, pre_production_clearances.parameters recorded with in_range flag; report.pdf returns application/pdf.
test_results.T1_list_and_initiate: PASS — /production-batches shows initiate-batch-btn (all users) and create-batch-btn (admins). Initiate dialog opens (initiate-batch-dialog), SKU list populated, submit navigates to /production-batches/<id>/run.
test_results.T2_wizard_pre_section: PASS — wizard-sku-name shows 'Demo 500ml' (rendered uppercase via CSS), 5-step wizard-stepper visible, wizard-pre-section lists ZZ TEST Dosing tank row (run-check-<id>) with '1 parameter' badge, wizard-start-btn disabled, wizard-start-blocked visible.
test_results.T3_pre_param_capture_and_start: PASS — clicking run-check-tick-<id> opens param-capture-dialog; capture-submit disabled until pressure entered; entering 3 + submit updates row with run-check-params-<id>='Pressure: 3 bar', wizard-progress='1/1 done', wizard-start-btn enabled. Start → wizard-production-section with wizard-elapsed timer.
test_results.T4_stop_and_post: PASS — wizard-stop-btn disabled empty; enter crates=40 enables it; stop → wizard-post-section (ZZ TEST Filler CIP row) + wizard-create-section prefilled (batch code B-130926-101, crates=40, bpc=24). wizard-create-btn disabled, wizard-create-blocked visible. Ticking post row with pressure=4 enables create button.
test_results.T5_edit_and_create: PASS — editing wizard-final-crates to 42 and clicking wizard-create-btn navigates to /production-batches/<id>; production-run-panel visible with run-report-link. List card (batch-card-<id>) shows batch code as 'Created' with 42 crates / 1,008 bottles.
test_results.T6_resume_and_banner: PASS — second Initiate created a draft; on list, batch-run-in-progress-<id> badge and batch-resume-run-<id> tag visible. /production-batches/<id> shows batch-run-in-progress-banner with 'Resume production run' button (batch-resume-run-btn) that opens the wizard.
test_results.T7_cancel_run: PASS — In wizard, Cancel run (wizard-cancel-run, window.confirm accepted) navigates to /production-batches and the draft is gone (batch-run-in-progress-<id> not visible).
test_results.T8_legacy_quick_create: PASS — create-batch-btn opens Quick Create (legacy) modal with SKU/Batch Code/Date/pH/Packaging/Total Crates (batch-total-crates-input) fields and batch-run-flow-hint text 'Legacy direct entry: the batch is recorded straight away…'. Backend behaviour of legacy modal (use_run_workflow=false, direct create when no pending pre-run checks) is exercised by existing regression tests.

critical_code_review_comments: ProductionRunWizard.js line 88 merges checklist.items and checklist.post_items into the pre-section. This means any orphaned pending post_run_tasks from previously deleted/cancelled batches for the same equipment will appear in the *pre*-checklist of a fresh run (observed during testing — a leftover post_task from a killed test batch showed as an AFTER RUN row on the fresh run's pre-checklist and blocked Start). It is functionally correct (cleanup owed before the next run) but confusing — consider surfacing these as a distinct 'pending cleanups from prior runs' section rather than mixing them with the SKU's own pre-run items, or ensure cancel_run also removes orphan post_run_tasks.

InitiateBatchDialog.js useEffect deps only include [skuId] but reads sku (derived from skus). eslint-disable is applied; consider using sku?.allows_child_skus directly and adding it as a dep to avoid stale-closure surprises.
ProductionRunWizard.js: the SKU name is rendered as text-3xl uppercase tracking-tight — the h1 loses the SKU's original casing which can matter for branded SKUs with mixed-case names.
wizard-final-code allows arbitrary strings without client-side uniqueness hint; server rejects duplicates with 400 (verified) but a lightweight duplicate check onBlur would be nicer UX.
No client-side unmount cleanup of the 1-second setInterval in Elapsed component if `since` is undefined (defensive but works currently).

Post-checklist rows use task_id (not equipment_id) — use querySelector('[data-testid^="run-check-tick-"]') inside wizard-post-section to find them. Legacy modal: create-batch-btn, batch-total-crates-input, batch-run-flow-hint, batch-skip-qc-checkbox. Cleanup queries: production_batches by batch_code regex ^ZZ-WIZ|^B-<ddmmyy>, post_run_tasks by equipment_id in {test_ids}, equipment_master by name regex ^ZZ TEST, notifications by title regex 'Production run closed|B-<ddmmyy>'.
rca of the issue: No issues — feature works as designed. Only minor UX suggestion: orphan post_run_tasks from cancelled/deleted batches appear in fresh runs' pre-checklist which is intentional but can be confusing.
